text:
Happy Friday evening! It's a gray, breezy finish to October, 52 now and slipping. Sunset comes at 5:44 under mostly cloudy skies, and the clouds should start breaking up after dark. Tonight we're partly cloudy and chilly, with a low around 34. It'll be a jacket night, and the windshield could be a little cold in the morning.

Saturday looks like the pick of the weekend. Sunshine, light wind, and a high near 50, though the European model and a couple of the TV forecasts lean a few degrees cooler, so upper 40s to 50 is a fair bet. The air will be very dry, and with dry leaves around I'd skip the outdoor burning. For Halloween trick-or-treating, it'll be dry and clear but cold, so plan on layers under the costumes. Saturday night drops to around 30, with frost likely.

Sunday brings more sunshine and a warmer southerly breeze, with a high near 57 and a low around 41 that night. It's a nice day for a long walk or ride. The milder air keeps building Monday, with highs from the upper 50s toward the mid 60s. A few sprinkles are possible early Monday, but nothing to plan around.

The next real rain holds off until late next week. The models still disagree on how much, so I'd wait before making plans for Wednesday night and Thursday.

WCAX METEOROLOGIST (regional station — Burlington relevance only, never their branding): BURLINGTON, Vt. (WCAX) - Our cool-down brings a cloudier but crisp finish to October across Vermont and northern New York, followed by a sunny Halloween weekend. A Lake Wind Advisory remains in effect today as northwesterly winds build waves on Lake Champlain. Dry leaves and breezy conditions also raise fire weather concerns, even after the recent showers. Temperatures will gradually climb into the 60s early next week before shower chances return later in the week. DAYTIME: High 48°. Expect plenty of sunshine for Halloween, with lighter winds than Friday. Dry leaves and low humidity will continue to raise fire weather concerns. Friday’s high will reach 57°, with a better chance of steady rain late Friday evening. The timing and amount of late-week rain are still uncertain.
